Name: JP's Dreaming of Strawberries
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#ff00ff][u][center]Dreaming of Strawberries[/center][/u][/color][/size][/i][/b]

[color=#00ff00][size=5][i][b][u]Strawberry Fields Forever[/u]...[/b][/i][/size][/color]


[i][b][size=5]This mod combines items from the game called [color=#00ffff]"Celeste"[/color] with many other items related to strawberries. [color=#ffff00][u]All items are designed for a balanced experience, none of the benefits granted by the items can be obtained so easily[/u][/color]! Enjoy your fill on a farm full of strawberries![/size][/b][/i]

[color=#00ffff][b][i]
[size=6][u]Content of the Mod:[/u][/size][/i][/b][/color]


[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]The mod will guide you through the days with mails that will arrive in your mailbox and give you useful information about the content of the mod.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Most new items (seeds, recipes, decorations) will only appear in specific seasons or in the second year. You will also be informed about this in the mails. [/size][/font]
[/list][list]
[*][size=4]In addition to some strawberry-themed decorations, the [color=#ff0000][b]"Strawnimos"[/b][/color], the distant cousins of the Junimos arrive in the valley! They are very cute and varied decorations (for the moment) for you to fill the whole farm with them. You will be able to find them in Robin's Carpentry, in the Travelling Merchant and in the Night Market. [/size]
[/list]
[b][i][color=#00ff00][u]
[size=6]Translations:
[/size][/u][/color][/i][/b][color=#ff7700][size=5][b][i]If you are interested in translating this mod to your language, you are free to do it, just let me know before doing it :) you can publish it on your own.
Everything you need to translate is in the i18n folders.[/i][/b][/size][/color]



[color=#00ff00][size=6][b][i]I think that's all, feel free to report problems or questions. I hope you enjoy the mod, long live the strawberries![/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]
